Counted anyway because unsure: Electrical Engineering - Global (B.S.E.E.). Excluded: teaching majors/minors, minors, certificates, A.A./A.S. and graduate entries. One verified 'bachelor' record is General Management (M.B.A.) (program_key general-management-m-b-a) and is mislabelled.
